# Where to Find Olive Oil

## Grocery Stores
- Supermarkets (regular cooking section)
- Specialty food stores
- International/Mediterranean markets
- Warehouse clubs (Costco, Sam's Club)

## Online Retailers
- Amazon
- Walmart.com
- Target.com
- Specialty oil retailers

## Physical Specialty Shops
- Gourmet food stores
- Italian/Greek markets
- Farmer's markets
- Local oil producers

## What to Look For
- **Location**: Usually near cooking oils and vinegars
- **Brands**: Varies by region (Italian, Spanish, Greek are common)
- **Price range**: Budget to premium options available
- **Labels**: Look for "extra virgin" or "virgin" for quality

## Tips
- Check expiration dates
- Compare prices across stores
- Consider buying in bulk if used frequently
- Some specialty oils are at premium prices—compare value
